signal_gate.scope: data-supply screening only;not accuracy,convergence or post-training success

next_training_rule: If supply passes,inspect real preference semantics before independently registered full10k data construction and matched continuation-SFT/DPO training;no automatic small-audit training or GRPO/PPO
limits: 512 distinct training images from full32985QA pool;fixed already-trained seed42 policy;not unseen-dev or formal benchmark improvement
four stochastic responses per question share one policy/image;not four training seeds or IID independent questions
Consensus-derived preference is rule-based using ten human reference answers,not direct human preference judgments or guaranteed semantic correctness
A positive canonical-score gap can reflect wording differences;semantic case review required before full training
Reward diversity at one policy does not establish online GRPO viability or convergence;group advantages are diagnostics with population std
Initial DPO forward/backward checks make no optimizer updates,save no trained adapter and do not establish DPO gains
Historical dev/final inputs excluded by image ID and pixel/file hash;answers supplied only after generation,never to generation prompts
Frozen BF16 inference and BF16 LoRA gradient precheck are isolated from historical NF4/FP32 SFT;no new BF16 training speed claim
JD corpus is a convenience sample;official jobs,announcements,Agent-specific roles and social jobs counted separately;not market prevalence or HC
